name: io.github.cruxible-ai/cruxible-core
description: Hard state for AI agents: typed, governed, durable state with deterministic queries, governed writes, and receipts.

environmentVariables.name: CRUXIBLE_SERVER_SOCKET
environmentVariables.description: Unix socket of a running Cruxible daemon (start one with `cruxible server start`)

environmentVariables.name: CRUXIBLE_SERVER_URL
environmentVariables.description: HTTP base URL of a Cruxible daemon, used instead of a socket

environmentVariables.name: CRUXIBLE_MCP_WORKSPACE_ROOT
environmentVariables.description: Workspace for tools that read or write local files; defaults to the working directory

environmentVariables.name: CRUXIBLE_MCP_PROFILE
environmentVariables.description: Tool catalog: unset for the writer path, or expert for the complete catalog

environmentVariables.name: CRUXIBLE_MODE
environmentVariables.description: Transport tier ceiling: admin (default), graph_write, governed_write, or read_only
